declared_readings: Indents: x += left (+ first_line on the paragraph's first line), width -= left + first + right, from the free gap with obstacles; a slot without width is skipped (still the first line). UNVERIFIED (D5).
Split sub-columns narrow the same way; a sub-column left without width is invalid_geometry (Studio reading, matches the existing sub_w refusal).

Spacing: space_after held and added with the next space_before as one gap; none at a column top (cursor.line == 0) or at a band top after a span; a push past the bottom drops it; same-style suppression uses this paragraph's effective flag and a shared non-null style_ref; span/split take max(flow, attribute); a break sentinel drops the pending value. Negative space moves lines up, unclamped. UNVERIFIED (D5).

Token (STU-TYP-130): no token added; these fields are new inputs, zero settings compose bit-identically (tests/indent_spacing.rs zero_indents_and_spacing_compose_bit_identically), settings holding only these fields leave paragraph_params' composer/H&J/hyphenation the request's; composer_depth_diff table untouched and green; d5_id_oracle rows unchanged and green with the IDML zeros now stored.

last_line_indent: right-side indent of the last line; one re-break when positive, Latin, outside split columns, the line fitted before, the narrowed width > 0 and holds the line's widest box, and the line's tightest width (Adobe: less the allowed word-space shrink) exceeds it; else the breaks stand and the line is overfull; negative widens at the set stage only; CJK and split paragraphs set-stage only. UNVERIFIED (D5).
Typed edit: StylePatch.composition is merged into the style's style_composition record field by field (Some(None) removes the record; a single field cannot be unset by the patch).

Text edits (F1): an edited paragraph is owned by the first original paragraph whose first byte maps into it (its style, direction and paragraph-keyed records); inserted-only paragraphs take the style of the paragraph the edit starts, else of the owner before them, and carry no records. InDesign parity UNVERIFIED (D5).
